code:
(λx.λy.x) y
=α  (λx.λz.x) y        # rename bound y to fresh z (safe because z is not free in argument)
->β  [x := y] (λz.x)    # now substitute y for x
->β  λz.y               # correct: a function that ignores z and returns the free y
description: This reduction alpha-renames an inner bound variable before substituting a free y.

steps.description: The application passes the free variable y to a function whose body contains an inner λy.
Alpha conversion renames the inner bound y to fresh z before substitution.

steps.answer: The substitution replaces x with the original free variable y.
steps.question: Which variable replaces x after the alpha rename?

steps.description: Beta reduction now substitutes y for x inside λz.x.
The result λz.y keeps y free. The function ignores z and returns y.

title: Avoid variable capture
